name: @kitty-crow/neru
description: Build and boot NERU Linux-WASM while attaching one authoritative Thistle userspace.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --check bin/neru-linux-runtime.mjs && node --check runtime/node-worker-bootstrap.mjs && python3 -m py_compile scripts/prepare-userland.py scripts/patch-linux-runtime.py
scripts.test: npm run build && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && node --test dist/tests/*.test.js
